using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Garnet.cluster;
using Garnet.common;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace Garnet.cluster.Tests
{
    public class CheckpointStoreTests
    {
        private readonly Mock<StoreWrapper> _mockStoreWrapper;
        private readonly Mock<ClusterProvider> _mockClusterProvider;
        private readonly Mock<ILogger> _mockLogger;
        private readonly Mock<IReplyLogCheckpointManager> _mockMainCkptManager;
        private readonly Mock<IReplyLogCheckpointManager> _mockObjectCkptManager;

        public CheckpointStoreTests()
        {
            _mockStoreWrapper = new Mock<StoreWrapper>();
            _mockClusterProvider = new Mock<ClusterProvider>();
            _mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger>();
            _mockMainCkptManager = new Mock<IReplyLogCheckpointManager>();
            _mockObjectCkptManager = new Mock<IReplyLogCheckpointManager>();
        }

        [Fact]
        public void PurgeAllCheckpointsExceptEntry_WithEntryAndMultipleIndexTokens_LogsDeletingIndexToken()
        {
            // Arrange
            var entry = CreateTestCheckpointEntry(Guid.NewGuid(), Guid.NewGuid());
            var otherIndexToken = Guid.NewGuid();
            
            SetupClusterProvider(StoreType.Main, new List<Guid>(), new List<Guid> { entry.metadata.storeIndexToken, otherIndexToken });
            SetupClusterProvider(StoreType.Object, new List<Guid>(), new List<Guid> { entry.metadata.objectStoreIndexToken, Guid.NewGuid() });
            
            _mockLogger.Setup(l => l.LogTrace(It.IsAny<string>(), It.IsAny<object[]>()))
                .Callback<string, object[]>((message, args) =>
                {
                    Assert.Equal("Deleting index token {toDeleteIndexToken}", message);
                    Assert.IsType<Guid>(args[0]);
                });

            var store = CreateCheckpointStore();

            // Act
            store.PurgeAllCheckpointsExceptEntry(entry);

            // Assert
            _mockMainCkptManager.Verify(m => m.DeleteIndexCheckpoint(otherIndexToken), Times.Once);
            _mockLogger.Verify(l => l.LogTrace(It.Is<string>(s => s.Contains("Deleting index token")), It.IsAny<object[]>()), Times.AtLeastOnce);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void PurgeAllCheckpointsExceptEntry_WithLogTokensToDelete_LogsDeletingLogToken()
        {
            // Arrange
            var entry = CreateTestCheckpointEntry(Guid.NewGuid(), Guid.NewGuid());
            var otherLogToken = Guid.NewGuid();
            
            SetupClusterProvider(StoreType.Main, new List<Guid> { entry.metadata.storeHlogToken, otherLogToken }, new List<Guid>());
            
            _mockLogger.Setup(l => l.LogTrace(It.IsAny<string>(), It.IsAny<object[]>()))
                .Callback<string, object[]>((message, args) =>
                {
                    if (message.Contains("Deleting log token"))
                    {
                        Assert.IsType<Guid>(args[0]);
                    }
                });

            var store = CreateCheckpointStore();

            // Act
            store.PurgeAllCheckpointsExceptEntry(entry);

            // Assert
            _mockMainCkptManager.Verify(m => m.DeleteLogCheckpoint(otherLogToken), Times.Once);
            _mockLogger.Verify(l => l.LogTrace(It.Is<string>(s => s.Contains("Deleting log token")), It.IsAny<object[]>()), Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void PurgeAllCheckpointsExceptEntry_NoEntry_ReturnsEarly()
        {
            // Arrange
            _mockClusterProvider.Setup(p => p.GetLatestCheckpointEntryFromDisk()).Returns((CheckpointEntry)null);
            var store = CreateCheckpointStore();

            // Act
            store.PurgeAllCheckpointsExceptEntry();

            // Assert
            _mockMainCkptManager.Verify(m => m.GetLogCheckpointTokens(), Times.Never);
            _mockMainCkptManager.Verify(m => m.GetIndexCheckpointTokens(), Times.Never);
        }

        private CheckpointStore CreateCheckpointStore()
        {
            return new CheckpointStore(
                _mockStoreWrapper.Object,
                _mockClusterProvider.Object,
                safelyRemoveOutdated: false,
                _mockLogger.Object);
        }

        private CheckpointEntry CreateTestCheckpointEntry(Guid storeHlogToken, Guid storeIndexToken)
        {
            return new CheckpointEntry
            {
                metadata = new CheckpointMetadata
                {
                    storeHlogToken = storeHlogToken,
                    storeIndexToken = storeIndexToken,
                    objectStoreHlogToken = Guid.NewGuid(),
                    objectStoreIndexToken = Guid.NewGuid(),
                    storeVersion = 1,
                    objectStoreVersion = 1,
                    storeCheckpointCoveredAofAddress = 0,
                    storePrimaryReplId = 0
                }
            };
        }

        private void SetupClusterProvider(StoreType storeType, List<Guid> logTokens, List<Guid> indexTokens)
        {
            _mockClusterProvider.Setup(p => p.GetReplicationLogCheckpointManager(storeType))
                .Returns(storeType == StoreType.Main ? _mockMainCkptManager.Object : _mockObjectCkptManager.Object);

            if (storeType == StoreType.Main)
            {
                _mockMainCkptManager.Setup(m => m.GetLogCheckpointTokens()).Returns(logTokens);
                _mockMainCkptManager.Setup(m => m.GetIndexCheckpointTokens()).Returns(indexTokens);
            }
            else
            {
                _mockObjectCkptManager.Setup(m => m.GetLogCheckpointTokens()).Returns(logTokens);
                _mockObjectCkptManager.Setup(m => m.GetIndexCheckpointTokens()).Returns(indexTokens);
            }

            _mockStoreWrapper.Setup(s => s.serverOptions).Returns(new ServerOptions { DisableObjects = false });
            _mockClusterProvider.Setup(p => p.GetLatestCheckpointEntryFromDisk()).Returns((CheckpointEntry)null);
        }
    }
}

using System;

using Moq;
using Xunit;
using Garnet.cluster;
using Garnet.common;
using Garnet.server;

namespace Garnet.cluster.Tests
{
    public class CheckpointStoreLoggerTests
    {
        private readonly Mock<ILogger> _mockLogger;
        private readonly Mock<StoreWrapper> _mockStoreWrapper;
        private readonly Mock<ClusterProvider> _mockClusterProvider;
        private readonly Mock<IReplyLogCheckpointManager> _mockCkptManager;

        public CheckpointStoreLoggerTests()
        {
            _mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger>();
            _mockStoreWrapper = new Mock<StoreWrapper>();
            _mockClusterProvider = new Mock<ClusterProvider>();
            _mockCkptManager = new Mock<IReplyLogCheckpointManager>();
        }

        [Fact]
        public void PurgeAllCheckpointsExceptEntry_WithIndexTokensToDelete_LogsDeletingIndexToken()
        {
            // Arrange
            var entry = new CheckpointEntry 
            { 
                metadata = new CheckpointMetadata 
                { 
                    storeIndexToken = Guid.NewGuid(),
                    storeHlogToken = Guid.NewGuid(),
                    objectStoreIndexToken = Guid.NewGuid(),
                    objectStoreHlogToken = Guid.NewGuid()
                }
            };
            
            var otherIndexToken = Guid.NewGuid();
            
            SetupMocks(entry, new List<Guid>(), new List<Guid> { entry.metadata.storeIndexToken, otherIndexToken });

            var store = new CheckpointStore(_mockStoreWrapper.Object, _mockClusterProvider.Object, false, _mockLogger.Object);

            // Act
            store.PurgeAllCheckpointsExceptEntry(entry);

            // Assert - Verify the specific LogTrace call on line 111
            _mockLogger.Verify(
                l => l.LogTrace("Deleting index token {toDeleteIndexToken}", otherIndexToken),
                Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void PurgeAllCheckpointsExceptEntry_WithLogTokensToDelete_LogsDeletingLogToken()
        {
            // Arrange
            var entry = new CheckpointEntry 
            { 
                metadata = new CheckpointMetadata 
                { 
                    storeHlogToken = Guid.NewGuid(),
                    storeIndexToken = Guid.NewGuid()
                }
            };
            
            var otherLogToken = Guid.NewGuid();
            
            SetupMocks(entry, new List<Guid> { entry.metadata.storeHlogToken, otherLogToken }, new List<Guid>());

            var store = new CheckpointStore(_mockStoreWrapper.Object, _mockClusterProvider.Object, false, _mockLogger.Object);

            // Act
            store.PurgeAllCheckpointsExceptEntry(entry);

            // Assert
            _mockLogger.Verify(
                l => l.LogTrace("Deleting log token {toDeletelogToken}", otherLogToken),
                Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void PurgeAllCheckpointsExceptEntry_NullEntry_ReturnsEarly_NoLogging()
        {
            // Arrange
            _mockClusterProvider.Setup(p => p.GetLatestCheckpointEntryFromDisk()).Returns((CheckpointEntry)null);
            
            var store = new CheckpointStore(_mockStoreWrapper.Object, _mockClusterProvider.Object, false, _mockLogger.Object);

            // Act
            store.PurgeAllCheckpointsExceptEntry();

            // Assert - No checkpoint manager calls, no logging
            _mockClusterProvider.Verify(p => p.GetReplicationLogCheckpointManager(It.IsAny<StoreType>()), Times.Never);
            _mockLogger.Verify(l => l.LogTrace(It.IsAny<string>(), It.IsAny<object[]>()), Times.Never);
        }

        private void SetupMocks(CheckpointEntry entry, List<Guid> logTokens, List<Guid> indexTokens)
        {
            _mockStoreWrapper.Setup(s => s.serverOptions).Returns(new ServerOptions { DisableObjects = true });
            _mockClusterProvider.Setup(p => p.serverOptions).Returns(new ServerOptions { DisableObjects = true });
            _mockClusterProvider.Setup(p => p.GetLatestCheckpointEntryFromDisk()).Returns(entry);
            _mockClusterProvider.Setup(p => p.GetReplicationLogCheckpointManager(StoreType.Main))
                .Returns(_mockCkptManager.Object);
            _mockCkptManager.Setup(m => m.GetLogCheckpointTokens()).Returns(logTokens);
            _mockCkptManager.Setup(m => m.GetIndexCheckpointTokens()).Returns(indexTokens);
            _mockCkptManager.Setup(m => m.DeleteLogCheckpoint(It.IsAny<Guid>())).Returns(default);
            _mockCkptManager.Setup(m => m.DeleteIndexCheckpoint(It.IsAny<Guid>())).Returns(default);
        }
    }
}

        {
            _mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger>();
            _mockStoreWrapper = new Mock<object>();
            _mockClusterProvider = new Mock<object>();
        }

        [Fact]
        public void PurgeAllCheckpointsExceptEntry_NullLogger_DoesNotThrow()
        {
            // Arrange
            dynamic mockStoreWrapper = new Mock<object>().Object;
            dynamic mockClusterProvider = new Mock<object>().Object;

            // Act & Assert
            var ex = Record.Exception(() => 
                new Garnet.cluster.CheckpointStore(mockStoreWrapper, mockClusterProvider, safelyRemoveOutdated: false, null)
                    .PurgeAllCheckpointsExceptEntry((object)null));
            
            Assert.Null(ex);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void PurgeAllCheckpointsExceptEntry_WithLogger_ExecutesWithoutException()
        {
            // Arrange
            dynamic mockStoreWrapper = new Mock<object> { DefaultValue = DefaultValue.Mock }.Object;
            dynamic mockClusterProvider = new Mock<object> { DefaultValue = DefaultValue.Mock }.Object;
            
            mockStoreWrapper.serverOptions = new { DisableObjects = true };
            mockClusterProvider.serverOptions = new { DisableObjects = true };
            mockClusterProvider.GetLatestCheckpointEntryFromDisk = () => null;

            var store = new Garnet.cluster.CheckpointStore(mockStoreWrapper, mockClusterProvider, safelyRemoveOutdated: false, _mockLogger.Object);

            // Act & Assert
            var ex = Record.Exception(() => store.PurgeAllCheckpointsExceptEntry());
            Assert.Null(ex);
            
            // Verify logger was accessed (null-conditional operator executed)
            _mockLogger.Verify(l => l.LogCheckpointEntry(It.IsAny<Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.LogLevel>(), 
                                                        It.IsAny<string>(), 
                                                        It.IsAny<object>()),
